EGY.note: The court cites the Consumer Protection Law's article 29 in a telecoms case; no rule or complaints body for digital financial services is stated.

facts.fact: The Alexandria Economic Court, as reported by Khalf El Hadth, applied Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020, including its article 9, in judging a telecoms operator's duty to protect a customer's data.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020

facts.fact: The Alexandria Economic Court (case 554 of 2024) ordered a telecoms operator to pay EGP 10 million in damages for failing to protect a customer's personal data after an unauthorised SIM swap, citing Law 151 of 2020; the judgment date is not given.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020
